recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If duplicate Quantity data element entries reappear, investigate the core build/kindling dataelements generator rather than making a datatype source edit without a fresh source-level defect.
issue_request: FHIR-25430 reported that R4 dataelements.xml generated multiple StructureDefinition entries for de-Quantity.comparator and related Quantity child data elements, with slightly different content, and asked which was correct and whether the dataelements file should be fixed.
initial_application: No core source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-25430. The affected dataelements.xml artifact is generated rather than checked in; R4 publication output had three de-Quantity.comparator fullUrl entries, while R5 and the current CI build each have exactly one.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread asked the reporter to file a CR, and FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-13 record the Persuasive 7-0-0 decision. The current source has a single Quantity.comparator row in source/datatypes/quantity.xml, with SimpleQuantity and MoneyQuantity represented as profile constraints that no longer generate duplicate data element entries.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current generated specification already reflects the requested correction and there is no duplicate checked-in Quantity.comparator source row to edit.
